Name a pet whose sound is barking.
A dog barks.
Which farm animal commonly makes a mooing noise?
A cow moos.
What sound would I associate with a sheep?
A sheep bleats.
What noise is a horse known for making?
A horse neighs.
Does an owl belong with the birds or the mammals?
An owl is a bird.
Which category of animal would a crocodile fit into?
A crocodile is a reptile.
Should I group a bee with the insects?
A bee is an insect.
What kind of animal group contains rabbits?
A rabbit is a mammal.
A bat has wings so should I call it a bird?
No. A bat is a mammal, not a bird.
A penguin cannot take off into the sky. Does that stop it being a bird?
A penguin is a bird even though it cannot fly.
Can you give examples showing that birds do not all fly?
No. Penguins and ostriches are birds that cannot fly.
Whales swim in the ocean. Why are they not classed as fish?
A whale is a mammal. It breathes air and feeds its young milk.
What animal is most deadly when we count human deaths from disease?
By human deaths from transmitted diseases, mosquitoes are considered the deadliest animals.
How can something as small as a mosquito endanger people?
Some mosquitoes transmit germs that cause diseases such as malaria. That makes them dangerous to people.
Is becoming ill guaranteed whenever a mosquito bites?
Not every mosquito carries disease, and not every bite makes someone sick.
What helps a giraffe reach leaves high up?
Giraffes have long necks that help them reach leaves.
Why would it be wrong to call an eight legged spider an insect?
A spider is an arachnid with eight legs. An adult insect has six legs.
Hi, I would love to chat about animals.
Hello! How are you?
I want to learn about the penguin.
A penguin is a bird. Penguins cannot fly but are strong swimmers.
What kind of animal is that?
A penguin is a bird.
I want to learn about the bat.
A bat is a mammal. Bats are mammals that can fly.
What kind of animal is that?
A bat is a mammal.
I want to learn about the whale.
A whale is a mammal. Whales breathe air and feed their young milk.
What kind of animal is that?
A whale is a mammal.
